subdomains.name: Protean Subdomain (Chaos)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Chaos Blade with Aura of Chaos and replace the Chaos domain's 1st-, 3rd-, and 6th-level spells.

powers.name: Touch of Chaos
powers.summary: As a melee touch attack, force the target to roll twice and take the worse result on every d20 roll during its next round. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Aura of Chaos
powers.summary: Emit a 30-foot aura for rounds per day equal to cleric level. Enemies must declare an action and make a Will save; failure forces a different legal action, while success requires the declared action.

subdomains.name: Love Subdomain (Charm)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Dazing Touch with Adoration and replace the Charm domain's 2nd- and 8th-level spells.

powers.name: Adoration
powers.summary: As an immediate action after an attack is declared but before it is rolled, make that single attack subject to sanctuary. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Charming Smile
powers.summary: Cast charm person as a swift action with a save DC of 10 + half cleric level + Wisdom modifier. Only one creature can be charmed this way at a time. Usable for rounds per day equal to cleric level.

subdomains.name: Lust Subdomain (Charm)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Charming Smile with Anything to Please and replace the Charm domain's 2nd- and 4th-level spells.

powers.name: Dazing Touch
powers.summary: As a melee touch attack, daze a living creature with no more Hit Dice than cleric level for 1 round. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Anything to Please
powers.summary: As a standard action, compel a creature within 30 feet that fails a Will save to attack your enemies, surrender its most valuable item, or grovel. Usable once per day at 8th level, plus once per four levels beyond 8th.
